$comment: Provenance for the vendored copy of the BP+ JavaScript SDK in this folder.
This folder is a COPY. The SDK is developed at the repository named below,
and everything here comes from it unchanged.
Do not edit sdk/ in place. An edit that lives only here is lost the next
time the folder is replaced, and invisible until then -- which is not
hypothetical: this copy and the one in the UTas REDCap module drifted apart
across seven files while both reported SDK_VERSION 1.0.0, and nothing
showed until they were diffed. Change it upstream and re-copy.
treeSha256 identifies the copy: every .js file under sdk/, sorted by path
with an ordinal comparison, each hashed as UTF-8 with CRLF normalised to
LF, joined as 'path hash\n' lines, and the whole hashed again. The
bpplus-redcap repository has tools/sync-sdk.ps1, which both writes this
